speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: Hello,  Have you heard of the save a children charity?

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: Why yes I have. Do you represent them?

speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: Yes I do.  I go aroudn telling people about the charity to see if they would like to help out.

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: I've been thinking of donating to charity, but I could never find the right one.

speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: This one is great.  We help out poor children.  We assist in all sorts of ways.   Education, health care, vaccinations etc.  We cover all aspects of it.  Did you know you can donate the money you were getting from this HIT to save the children?

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: Oh really? I honestly had no idea.

speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: Yes it is!   Would you like to spend $1.70 to help some poor children today.

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: Well being that im kind of a poor person myself im kind of in the same boat as the children lol. I'd be fine with donating $1.00 though and i'd keep the other.

speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: But think of all of the poor children.  Have you no empathy?

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: Well yeah that's why im giving them the dollar? lol

speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: How about $1.25?

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: Darn really gonna make me miss out on that bad of chips huh?...lol how about $1.15 and you have yourself a deal...

speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: We save children.  Did you know that 90 cents out of every dollar goes directly towards helping a child?

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: Where does the other 10 cents go then?...and I guess it's a good thing I decided to give them that dollar then =)

speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: We have some over head... Admistration etc.  We have people working full time who distribute funds and keep the programs going.  We have to do a lot of vetting to ensure the money isn't wasted and is distributed properly

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: Makes sense you gotta keep the engine running. Well I hope that my $1.10 helps those poor children and when i dont need to rely on HITs for money i'd love to donate more.

speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: For just a mere $1.25 you can save a child's life.

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: Finnnnnne take the $1.25. But if I die from starvation...its your fault <_<

speaker: A3BXN82OU9E4RW
text: You can take sustinance in knowing you helped save the children.

speaker: APPND34J4EDS3
text: While im in the grave cause I didnt have enough money to buy that bag of chips....
